messages:
hana_cs: JunoAI started APAC pilot and hit our per-minute throttle. They asked for a short CIDR allow + per-route burst to validate.

marco_acct: Renewal risk: if pilot stalls conversion drops. They requested a 10-day window and proposed burst=420rps for /v1/chat from staging CIDR.

hana_cs: @sylvia_net can we allow 203.0.118.0/28 and 198.51.104.0/28? They also want header match X-Stage:Juno.

sylvia_net: Yep. Plan: add ipset entries, create rate window with auto-revoke TTL=10d, header allow. Recommend global_soft=650 to permit brief spikes.

ryan_sre: Tagging SRE review. I'll run a quick capacity check and add small-model fallback on overload. ETA 30m.

preflight-bot: APAC preflight OK. Suggest KV warm for juno prefix and p95 alert at 1500ms.

sylvia_net: Draft snippet:
```
# JunoAI pilot temp allowlist (10d)
ipset add junoai_203 203.0.118.0/28
ipset add junoai_198 198.51.104.0/28
route /v1/chat burst=420 per_route_soft=420 global_soft=650 headers.allow=X-Stage:Juno
# tag: junoai-3187659999
```

sylvia_net: Opening JIRA INF-7629. Auto-revoke webhook set for 10d.

hana_cs: Customer telemetry: 250-380ms median in us-east but 900-1.2s p95 in ap-northeast under bursts. They asked about token pin to ap-northeast-1.

ryan_sre: We can pin token to ap-northeast-1; lowers RTT but increases cost. I'll prepare cost delta for @marco_acct.

marco_acct: Please share cost delta before we enable pin. I'll note in renewal tracker that CS provided a pilot concession.

hana_cs: Scheduling a 30m enablement + runbook review Friday to validate prompts and monitor quality under load. Capture any regression correlated with higher qps.

ryan_sre: Change queued pending SRE signoff. INF-7629. Applying to staging now. Will monitor p95 and roll back if >1500ms.

sylvia_net: Live in prod. CIDRs allowed, rate window active, header rule enforced. Watchlist: junoai-3187659999.

hana_cs: :thumbsup: please ping when live so i can update the customer and run enablement. We'll review telemetry in 24h and record sentiment + any quality regressions.

marco_acct: I'll prepare usage + cost summary for day 7 and follow up renewal outreach.

hana_cs: Thanks team.
